purpose: Declare source-aligned Russian Twin and English Research companion hooks that can support a current technical lesson, prerequisite, schedule and НИР/ВКР milestone without forcing translated content, navigation or AI dependence before the multilingual rollout.

principles.rule: A language layer aligns concepts, terms, actions and evidence to a stable source lesson; it is not a duplicate lesson, an unsourced translation or a parallel progress record.
B7 declares capabilities and validation contracts only; hooks remain hidden until an authorized resolver activates them and full multilingual learner UI remains owned by L12.
The source artifact keeps its original language and version; aligned Russian, English or Vietnamese support never overwrites authoritative text.
Terminology or language support is a secondary facet and never changes a mathematics, programming, database, design, ML, system or research lesson into a language lesson.
Vietnamese rescue or aligned explanation can restore comprehension, but viewing or using it does not verify Russian or English production and does not satisfy Master-ready by itself.
English Research supports search, paper reading, evidence annotation, scientific writing and defense; it does not translate the whole app shell or replace official Bauman course language.
AI may draft alignment, terminology help or language feedback, but the result remains ai-inference until source-linked review and can never become an official source automatically.
Language support follows the active disclosure policy and never translates, reconstructs or reveals protected assessment answers before the submission boundary.
Previously resolved terminology, aligned text, deterministic exercises and repair routes remain usable offline without speech services or generative AI.

rules: A recommendation explains the language need, scope, expected learner action and estimated cost before activation.
AI advisory may recommend but cannot activate a hook, change its language role or mark language evidence verified.
A deterministic study plan activates only a pre-authorized policy and keeps an immediate learner defer control.
Unavailable source alignment or offline pack never blocks the source lesson, required assessment or existing subject engine.
Deactivation hides the companion surface without deleting source-independent learner evidence or language-state history.
One language may hold more than one role, but every role is explicit for a hook instance.
Russian Twin normally targets ru output while Vietnamese may be a rescue language and English may be a source-term language.
English Research normally targets en reading or output while Russian and Vietnamese may explain context.
Changing a support language never changes source identity, learner evidence identity or official assessment requirements.

hookEnvelope.identityRule: hookId remains stable for one source lesson, hook kind, objective scope and content version; array position or rendered locale is never identity.
hookEnvelope.objectiveRule: Every active hook supports a named lesson, language or research objective and never exists only to fill a bilingual UI slot.
hookEnvelope.sourceRule: sourceBindings reuse the Universal Lesson source binding contract and preserve original source language and precedence.
hookEnvelope.stateRule: Hook progress and evidence reference Personal Learning State; they do not create a second source-lesson completion flag.

rules: Aligned text points to versioned source anchors and never replaces the source text in place.
An AI draft stays unreviewed-ai-draft until a permitted reviewer checks meaning, terminology and protected tokens.
Official-source-original labels only an original authoritative artifact, never an AI or learner translation.
A source version change invalidates incompatible alignment and creates needs-repair rather than silently reusing it.
Alignment can be partial; missing units are reported as unavailable instead of fabricated.

deterministic-source-importer.condition: Only an unchanged artifact with verified authoritative origin, source identity, content version and integrity may be marked official-source-original.

curriculum-curator.condition: A curator reviews meaning, terminology, source anchors and protected tokens.

instructor-review.condition: An instructor may review alignment and pedagogical use but this does not verify learner mastery.

system-integrity-check.condition: A source version, checksum, protected-token or reference failure invalidates incompatible alignment.

learner-contribution.condition: A learner may propose an aligned term or output, retained as user evidence pending review.

ai-advisory.condition: AI output remains ai-inference and cannot promote itself to source-aligned, instructor-reviewed or official-source-original.

rules: Alignment review status describes companion-content provenance and quality, not learner competence or Master-ready verification.
No actor may set a status outside its declared set.
A reviewed alignment still requires a separate authorized B5 verifier for learner evidence.

identityRules: Official published direction code remains 09.04.01 in source metadata.
Code, formula, query, dataset and citation identity is preserved unless an explicit domain adapter declares a safe transformation.

rules: Terms align through conceptRef and source evidence, never through surface-string equality alone.
A missing Russian or English term remains missing rather than being invented from a generic dictionary guess.
Learner personal glossary entries remain user evidence until reviewed and never overwrite the shared glossary.
Term review and source version are independent from UI locale preference.

russianTwin.scope: A source-aligned Russian companion for the current technical or research lesson, connected to the dedicated Russian engine for language practice without rewriting either source.
activationSignals: current lesson has registered Russian alignment
technical Russian prerequisite is due or weak
Russian classroom lab НИР or ВКР output is approaching
rules: Russian Twin is an aligned companion, not a machine-translated clone of every lesson block.
Vietnamese rescue is available according to exposure policy but never verifies Russian production.
The dedicated Russian engine owns dialogue, shadowing, speech, handwriting, writing, review and exam interactions.
Technical symbols, code, formulas, SQL and citations remain protected tokens inside Russian narration.
No hook activates when source alignment is missing; the source lesson continues unchanged.

englishResearchLayer.scope: An evidence-grounded English layer for literature search, paper reading, research annotation, reproducible artifacts, scientific writing and defense across technical lessons and НИР/ВКР.
activationSignals: lesson objective requires an English paper or technical source
research question literature baseline or protocol milestone is active
НИР/ВКР artifact needs an English title abstract keywords or source annotation
weak topic includes research reading writing or defense language
learner explicitly requests English Research support
rules: English Research is not a whole-site locale and does not translate unrelated navigation or official course records.
Search terms, claims, methods, results, limitations and citations keep traceable source anchors.
AI paraphrase remains advisory and is checked for meaning, attribution, unsupported claim and plagiarism risk.
Language quality cannot compensate for invalid research method, evidence, source or reproducibility.
A missing English source is never synthesized and presented as a paper or official citation.
Exposure increases only for a named objective or learner choice and can be reduced without losing source-lesson access.
Rescue content is progressively reduced when independent target-language output is the objective.
Formal assessment exposure is capped by the active disclosure policy even if a richer companion pack is cached.
Transliteration may support recognition but never replaces required Cyrillic or source-script evidence.
Unavailable audio or speech recognition falls back to text, transcript, self-recording or instructor review.

evidenceBoundary.verificationRule: A hook event projects to Master-ready only when a named objective maps it to a registered type evidence output and an authorized B5 verifier verifies the learner artifact.
evidenceBoundary.supportRule: Using Russian or English support for a technical objective does not create language mastery; using language support for research does not verify research validity.
evidenceBoundary.repairRule: Language repair appends an aligned evidence link and never rewrites the source lesson or prior attempt.

rules: Assessment declares which language dimensions are scored and which are support-only.
Domain correctness and language quality remain separate rubric dimensions unless an official objective binds them.
A translated or rescue answer cannot satisfy target-language production.
Protected question answer hint or solution content is unavailable to both hooks and AI before submission.
Post-submission review links the exact source and one focused language or domain repair at a time.

aiBoundary.provenanceRule: AI output is stored or referenced as ai-inference with model or provider policy, prompt context refs, source refs, creation time and review status.
aiBoundary.offlineFallbackRule: When AI is unavailable, resolved glossary, source alignment, deterministic checks, exposure policy and recovery routes continue without queued AI verification.

rules: Resolved glossary and aligned text retain version integrity and deterministic lookup offline.
Large audio paper or media resources require explicit subject-pack or local-file authorization.
Speech recognition synthesis translation and generative AI are optional services, never required offline gates.
Local papers and notes remain zero-copy references under Direct Local Reader and sandbox policy.
Sync reconciles stable hook alignment and evidence IDs without silently replacing reviewed content.
Every aligned segment declares language and script so assistive technology changes pronunciation rules correctly.
Side-by-side alignment may stack but preserves source then companion then learner-action order.
Stress case grammar claim strength and protected-token notes are available as text, not color alone.
Audio has transcript and independent controls; timed content can be paused and replayed.
Mixed Cyrillic Latin code formula and citation spans retain explicit language or token boundaries.

typeProfileContract.usageRule: Profiles define allowed support modes; a lesson instantiates only hooks justified by source alignment, objective, context and learner activation.
typeProfileContract.secondaryFacetRule: A language hook never changes the primary lesson type or blind-merges the language block policy.

language.activationNotes: Russian may be the primary lesson objective here; English Research remains a scoped research-language companion unless the lesson objective explicitly targets English.

mathematics.activationNotes: Language support narrates assumptions, notation, dimensions, derivation and oral defense but never alters the mathematical expression or proof source.

programming.activationNotes: Explanations and reports may align across languages, while code identifiers, APIs, paths, versions and executable behavior remain exact.

database.activationNotes: Schema, query, transaction and plan explanations may align, while SQL tokens, identifiers, fields and engine version remain protected.

software-design.activationNotes: Language layers support requirement, architecture, tradeoff and defense language without translating diagram identity or inventing a canonical design.

ml-data.activationNotes: English Research is strongly applicable to papers and experiments, but language quality never masks leakage, invalid evaluation or unreproducible results.

asoiu-system.activationNotes: Russian supports Bauman system terminology and defense; English supports source and research work while boundaries, states and models remain source-grounded.

research.activationNotes: Russian supports НИР/ВКР work and defense; English Research supports international sources and writing while source integrity and method remain independent critical gates.

russian.ownership: The Russian engine retains dialogue, shadowing, deep speaking, speech, handwriting, writing, review and exam interactions.

research.ownership: Research content remains the source for methodology, artifacts, НИР/ВКР and defense; B7 only declares aligned language hooks.

forwardOwnership.L6-B8: formal instance schema, validator and version migration
forwardOwnership.L6-B9: Subject Factory registration and data-source resolution
forwardOwnership.L12: full multilingual learner UI, Russian Twin generation workflow and English Research experience
forwardOwnership.L13: contextual AI runtime and grounded provider policies
forwardOwnership.rule: B7 reserves executable hook semantics and profiles but does not claim translated content coverage, automatic generation, runtime rendering or full multilingual UI.

rollback.scope: Remove the B7 contract, decision record, generated report and workflow gate, then restore progress markers to the B6 checkpoint.
